identity.title: Prove deterministic replay from production-derived evidence

human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Use the production-derived EverRun fixture established by 8070/8071 to prove that repeated load -> ingest -> rebuild -> governed result produces identical canonical governance facts from identical evidence. Normalize only non-semantic storage/runtime metadata if necessary and document every exclusion.
human_pressure.why_now: A governance evaluator is not trustworthy if replaying the same evidence changes the judgment.
do_not_misread: Determinism applies to canonical governance facts, not incidental database ids or wall-clock test metadata.
Do not change projection semantics just to stabilize a snapshot.
red_lines: No hidden normalization of evidence payloads.

machine_core.goal: Lock deterministic replay of the current canonical governance pipeline against a real production-derived evidence fixture.
red_lines: Do not suppress unknowns or warnings to make outputs match.
invariants: Identical canonical evidence yields identical lifecycle, native outcome, governed outcome, validation, scope, governance records, coverage, signals and evidence refs.
Any excluded nondeterministic field is explicitly named and proven non-semantic.

observable_effect.assertion: Two independent replays of identical evidence produce equal canonical governance facts.

proofs.assertion: Focused replay test plus full suite pass.

failure_semantics: Any canonical fact drift is a replay regression and keeps the pack todo.
Incidental metadata drift must be documented rather than silently ignored.

steps.title: Select production-derived fixture
details: Use the fixture accepted by 8070/8071; do not invent a cleaner sample.

steps.title: Replay independently twice
details: Use separate disposable storage instances and the same production pipeline.

steps.title: Compare canonical facts
details: Assert equality for governance semantics and evidence attribution; document any intentionally excluded incidental fields.

steps.title: Run full validation
details: Run focused test and full suite.

acceptance: Same evidence produces identical canonical governance facts across independent replay.
No semantic field is excluded from comparison without evidence-backed rationale.

must_check: Canonical facts and evidence refs are compared.
reject_if: A synthetic replacement fixture is used without documenting unavailability.
A semantic field is dropped merely because it differs.
